Title: Add Back-office and Mobile frontends (Next.js)

Description:
Create two frontends: a Back-Office admin site and a Mobile/customer site using Next.js and a shared UI library.

Acceptance Criteria:
- `front_bo` and `front_m` Next.js apps scaffolded.
- Shared UI components packaged (local workspace) and consumed by both apps.
- Basic listing and signup flows implemented in UIs.
